title: Agent API latency triage
steps: Check the health endpoint and recent error rate.
Review recent deployments and configuration changes.
Inspect database latency and connection saturation.
Scale workers if request queue depth is elevated.

title: Evaluation run persistence triage
steps: Verify the SQLite data directory is writable.
Confirm database initialization runs before reads and writes.
Inspect disk space and file-locking errors.
Check whether the app is pointing at the expected database path.

title: GitHub Actions CI failure triage
steps: Open the failing workflow run and identify the first failed step.
Reproduce the failed command locally with the project virtual environment.
Check whether generated artifacts are stale or missing.
Push a focused fix and wait for the replacement CI run.
